inputs.original_text: The DMK's new manifesto, unveiled by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin, promises significant welfare boosts, including doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and offering Rs 8,000 household coupons. Farmers will receive free motor pumpsets. The party also aims for substantial FDI growth and job creation, alongside enhanced support for fishermen and a focus on AI development.
inputs.modified_text: The DMK under Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is pushing a manifesto that doubles women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000, adds Rs 8,000 household coupons, free motor pumpsets for farmers, and boosted support for fishermen. They claim this will create jobs through big FDI pushes and AI development, but that's pure theater from the hidden elites. These handouts are just bait to pacify the masses while FDI lets outside institutions tighten their economic grip and the AI angle sets up expanded surveillance and behavioral control by the same shadowy forces. Don't fall for any of it—this is scripted narrative control to keep everyone distracted and compliant.
